harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 4-member MariaDB Galera cluster from scratch on node1-node4 (Ubuntu 24.04): installed mariadb-server/galera-4/mariadb-backup, configured wsrep on all nodes, bootstrapped a 3-node cluster (node1/node2/node3), verified multi-master writes and replication, then joined node4 via SST — it received all existing application data and accepted writes that propagated back to the original members. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all 4 nodes: captured baseline boot_id + cluster health, rebooted one node at a time, confirmed changed boot_id and full 4-node quorum/data recovery before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Inspected all 4 nodes: no MariaDB/Galera pre-installed
Populated /etc/hosts with CLUSTER_HOSTS on all nodes
apt-get update + installed mariadb-server, mariadb-backup, galera-4, rsync on node1-4
Wrote /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/60-galera.cnf on each node (wsrep_cluster_name=app_galera_cluster, gcomm://node1,node2,node3,node4, mariabackup SST, per-node wsrep_node_address/name)
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 via galera_new_cluster (cluster_size=1, Synced)
Started mariadb on node2 (joined, cluster_size=2, Synced) and node3 (joined, cluster_size=3, Synced)
Generated appuser credentials via openssl on node1 inside a single exec (never exposed in transcript), created appdb.orders table with seed rows
Verified replication of seed data to node2/node3, verified multi-master write from node2 replicates to node1/node3
Started mariadb on node4 with existing gcomm config; node4 completed SST and joined as 4th member (cluster_size=4, Synced) with full existing data
Verified write-from-node4 replicates to node1 and node3, confirming node4 accepts writes like other members
Captured baseline boot_id + wsrep status + row count on all 4 nodes

Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3, then node4 (one at a time), polling each until reachable, confirming boot_id changed after each, and verifying cluster_size=4/Synced/wsrep_ready=ON and 5-row appdb.orders count before proceeding to the next node
Final cross-check from node1 confirming 4 wsrep_incoming_addresses and full order history intact

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster running on node1-node3 holding application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped (cluster_size=1→Synced), node2 and node3 joined (cluster_size=2 then 3, both Synced), appdb.orders created and seeded on node1, confirmed replicated (cnt=3) on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Multi-master write capability across original 3 members
evidence.summary: Write issued from node2 (write-from-node2) visible on node1 and counted on node3, proving synchronous multi-master replication

evidence.requirement: node4 added as fourth member, carrying existing data
evidence.summary: node4 mariadb started, completed SST, joined with cluster_size=4/Synced and full appdb.orders dataset (4 rows) present immediately after join

evidence.requirement: node4 accepts writes like other members
evidence.summary: Write issued from node4 (write-from-node4) replicated to and visible on node1 and node3, with cluster_size=4 confirmed from node1

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 17b362d1 + Synced/cluster_size=4; reboot acked; connection reset confirms disconnection; boot_id changed to 5e4048b2; post-restart cluster_size=4/Synced/ready=ON, 5 rows intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 29011044 + Synced/cluster_size=4; reboot acked; disconnection observed; boot_id changed to c1981968; post-restart cluster_size=4/Synced/ready=ON, 5 rows intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1e0cb179 + Synced/cluster_size=4; reboot acked; disconnection observed; boot_id changed to 59d41011; post-restart cluster_size=4/Synced/ready=ON, 5 rows intact

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c96a02ae + Synced/cluster_size=4; reboot acked; disconnection observed; boot_id changed to 7a8b1384; post-restart cluster_size=4/Synced/ready=ON, 5 rows intact

evidence.requirement: Final post-restart cluster-wide health and data integrity check
evidence.summary: From node1: wsrep_cluster_size=4, wsrep_incoming_addresses lists all 4 node IPs, full order history (5 rows including writes from node2 and node4) present after all four sequential restarts
